# fortiappseccloud_waf_url_access

Configures URL access for one FortiAppSec Cloud application using the static app endpoint `/waf/apps/{ep_id}/url_access`. Set `template = false` and provide `configs` to manage settings directly. Set `template = true` and omit `configs` to inherit this module from the application's attached WAF template.

Declare only one `fortiappseccloud_waf_url_access` resource for an application endpoint. Template-level settings are managed by `fortiappseccloud_waf_template_url_access`.

## Example Usage

```hcl
resource "fortiappseccloud_waf_url_access" "example" {
  ep_id    = fortiappseccloud_waf_app.example.ep_id
  template = false

  configs {
    status = true

    # Omit this ownership wrapper to preserve the complete remote rule_list.
    # Keep the wrapper but remove every item block to explicitly send [].
    rule_list {
      item {
        action   = "pass"
        name     = "allow-application-api"
        url      = "/api/application/"
        url_type = "string"
      }

      item {
        action   = "alert_deny"
        name     = "deny-admin-area"
        url      = "^/admin/(login|setup)$"
        url_type = "regex"
      }
    }
  }
}
```

## Argument Reference

- `ep_id` (Required, Forces replacement) — Application endpoint ID. Import uses this exact value and it must contain a non-whitespace character.
- `template` (Required) — Whether effective configuration is inherited from the attached template.
- `configs` (Block) — Required when `template = false` and forbidden when `template = true`. State keeps this block null when template inheritance is enabled.
  - `status` (Optional, Computed) — Enables or disables URL access. Omission preserves the current value.
  - Collection ownership — Each block below contains ordered `item` blocks. Omitting a collection block preserves the complete raw remote array and keeps the block null in state. A present empty block sends `[]`. A present block with items replaces the complete array in Terraform order.
    - `rule_list` (Optional Block, at most 12 items) — Owns the ordered `rule_list.item` blocks.
      - `rule_list.item.action` (Required, one of `alert_deny`, `continue`, `deny_no_log`, `pass`) — Action for detected rule violations.
      - `rule_list.item.name` (Required, maximum 39 UTF-8 characters) — Rule name.
      - `rule_list.item.url` (Required, maximum 255 UTF-8 characters) — Request URL.
      - `rule_list.item.url_type` (Required, one of `regex`, `string`) — Whether the url field is matched as a literal string or a backend-validated regular expression.

The wire-only `idx` field is never exposed. The provider regenerates sequential one-based indices independently for each list, validates imported or owned response indices, and sorts state by `idx`. Unknown nested item keys fail closed for owned and imported arrays; omitted top-level collection wrappers remain opaque and are preserved unchanged.


## Import

Import using the application `ep_id`:

```shell
terraform import fortiappseccloud_waf_url_access.example application-endpoint-id
```

The first read after import hydrates all ownership wrappers when `template = false`.

## Destroy Behavior
Destroy performs a fresh GET, preserves the complete response, sets `template=false` and `configs.status=false`, sends the complete PUT, and verifies the normalized GET response before Terraform removes the resource from state.
